what_is_actually_built: The platform uses IOT sensors to gather real-time energy data from buildings, which is then passed to an IOT core for secure device management. This data goes to an AI engine where machine learning algorithms forecast energy demand and identify electricity system abnormalities. An interactive, user-friendly dashboard is built using Firebase and Chart.js to display energy usage and carbon footprint.
A decentralized digital platform for managing, accessing, and sharing medical records and insurance claims.

The project has built deliberation engines, a functional debate system, an ISD weighted voting engine, a pump sensor and selector for real-time mechanism learning, and tool-calling functionality for agents (web search, file analysis, code execution in a sandbox). A front-end visualizes agent activity, tool calls, entropy metrics, and consensus forms. A benchmark dashboard with a heatmap and analytics is also built. Declarations are set up in Google's library, and Solana contracts are deployed.

An investment ecosystem user app with a commodity marketplace and secondary market, field-agent apps with IoT sensor integration, and a supply chain system for real-time distribution, tracking, and inventory management. An MVP (referred to as 'MBP-pass 1') has been successfully deployed.

A prototype system that collects user health data via IoT sensors, sends it to a back-end system for processing using a machine learning model, and displays the results on a live dashboard. Sensor integration and real-time data display flows are currently being improved and tested.

A mobile interface for patients to add medical records, generate temporary QR codes for sharing, and revoke access. A browser-based interface for doctors to view shared records. Integration with Solana for record attestation, grant issuance, and revocation.
A system that allows uploading of zero-tag images of crop damage, verifies claims, and stores the results transparently on-chain. An MVP is available.

The platform is intended to allow students to generate AI-powered quizzes and study papers, upload academic work, and participate in a decentralized learning environment where contributions have measurable value.

The project has an anchor program live on Solana DevNet, a five-sensor simulated cluster for aggregated consensus, an on-chain hardware identity schema, a public website, and an EQS wide page. A hardware prototype is underway, with one sensor set assembled during the hackathon.

The project has built its own hardware stack, including custom ESG32-based electronics and a pressure-sensor array designed to capture foot-level biomechanics. This is described as a working sensing system, not a mock-up. AI modules are built to process raw sensor signals into activity representation and risk insights, identifying responses for movements like walking, stairs, squatting, sitting, and balance.

A web application with separate dashboards for physiotherapists and patients. The physiotherapist dashboard allows for patient onboarding, subscription plan selection, exercise assignment, and viewing patient progress, credibility scores, and payment history. The patient dashboard facilitates payment of fees, performing exercises with a tracking and verification system, and viewing rewards. A system for rewarding caregivers and providing on-chain certifications is also built.

A continuous care platform with a patient engagement layer and a provider dashboard for clinical research support. It includes Solana integrations for a portable health ID and tamper-proof consent. The system is being used to launch multiple chronic health programs across clinics in the EU and DGC.

The project claims to offer an AI Search Engine, development tools (CribTools), AI agent creation (CribAI Agents), educational resources (CribEdu), an app and game publishing platform (CribStore), and an email service (CribMail). The extent of actual implementation and functionality for these features is unclear without further evidence.

A mobile game for Solana Mobile is built and live, featuring a 'Seraro mode' where players pay a fee to compete. It includes a 'first byte mode' for challenges and integrates phone sensor reading (accelerometer, gyro, GPS, steps) for proof of human verification.

A web interface that displays active prediction markets. Users can select a market, input an amount of SOL to invest, view potential returns, confirm the purchase, sign a Solana transaction, and receive a Solscan transaction link. The system is designed to hold funds in a vault and allow winners to claim payouts upon market resolution.

The demo shows a user interface for describing manufacturing problems, uploading reference images, and displaying AI-generated solution options for selection. The system is shown proposing three different types of solutions.

A platform with a user interface that allows creators to generate cinematic image variations, convert them into full-body reference sheets, animate characters using an AI video model with grid-based animation and cinematic camera walks, and generate AI music tracks. It includes a fully functional on-chain top-up system on Solana Mainnet for credit purchases using SPL-USDC.
A drug supply chain verification system built with React, Anchor, and Solana Devnet, which is deployed and live.

A Solana development RPC that compiles and deploys programs to a CSCO session, provides a URL for RPC cluster replacement, and allows running Anchor tests. It includes a web interface (app.ca.run) to view transaction sessions, displaying transaction lists, CPI chains, logs, account state changes, source code traces, a VM execution view (disassembly, register state transitions), and account read information for both user and external programs.
A conceptual real-time learning environment designed to provide context and memory to AI agents through paper trading.
An SDK (Software Development Kit) for intellectual property management, as indicated by the 'sdk-monorepo' in the repository link.

A system that encrypts shipping addresses client-side using X25519 NaCl box and AES-256-GCM, wrapping them to the public key of the fulfillment partner. It supports burn-to-claim mechanisms and direct SOL/USDC/SPL sales.
Proprietary hardware has been built. The first four games are very close to being online.

An iMessage interface for user interaction, functionality to upload PDF medical records, processing of PDFs to extract allergies and medications, an appointment booking system, an access control mechanism for doctors, a revoke record button, a Solana Anchor program for audit logging, a LangGraph orchestration layer, and a RAG pipeline for retrieving medical context.

A system that issues Solana-anchored digital passports for diamonds at the point of extraction, tracks them through the supply chain, and allows users to view the full history by scanning a QR code without needing an app or account.

The current implementation is live on Serenite (Solana) and includes an Anchor settlement program, merchant and campaign accounts, a reward escrow, claim passes, and terminal confirmation for real-world conversions. It features nullifier-based replay protection and a working protocol path, not just a front-end mock-up. The system generates deterministic proof packets for transactions and requires real secrets for product and path signing.

A minimum viable product (MVP) that allows a user to claim work, provide a link to it, name collaborators, and receive confirmation from those collaborators. This process creates a verifiable, on-chain credit record for individuals.
A system that tracks vital health parameters like heart rate and temperature using IoT devices, with data displayed in real-time through a web dashboard. A prototype exists.

The project has built a system that intercepts live ML training telemetry, autonomously evaluates bias, issues a Trust Score, triggers an on-chain System Lockdown, and generates legally admissible PDF certificates.
A fully automated, non-custodial grid trading protocol on Solana has been built.

A system that processes vital data, analyzes stress and energy patterns, and provides daily personalized advice or plans. A 'session' interface is shown in the demo, which includes text-based advice. A monthly subscription menu is mentioned but not completed.
A system that facilitates escrow payments, real-time tracking, and provides a dashboard for property managers, which has been built and tested in Lagos, Nigeria.

The project is currently being built and is in active talks with MAS for an AI governance sandbox, and scoping a pilot with a Tier 1 foreign bank in Singapore. It includes a system that intercepts employee questions to AI, applies deterministic rules, and hashes records on Solana.
A real voice-first hardware device (crypto peripheral built on open hardware) running real Solana transactions on DevNet. A session key program is also built and is getting ready for audits.

A system that enables users to capture images of trading cards, processes these images with AI for visual assessment, facilitates community review and voting on the card's condition, and records the final grade as a sealed, publicly verifiable record. The project has real testers, real sealed proofs, and real votes.

The platform allows users to create a fully legal company in the United States jurisdiction. It includes functionality to raise capital, pay dividends and salaries, and accept payments globally. A delegation layer is built to connect AI agents for autonomous treasury management, transactions, and routine tasks. An agent-to-agent infrastructure is implemented to integrate various AI models and agents. The system supports over 45 blockchains. It features on-chain KYC/accreditation, OFAC screening, and PDA-secured vaults. Dual-role governance is implemented with GPs managing operations via SBTs and OPs holding supreme authority.
A platform that allows hardware engineers to share projects and collaborate, with features for crowdfunding.

A decentralized AI inference marketplace on Solana with an OpenAI-compatible endpoint that routes AI requests. It also includes features for privacy and verifiability through encrypted requests, hardware-backed execution, and remote attestation.

A live dashboard at solgov.xyz is built, featuring a real-time governance activity feed, protocol profiles, 'Good Watch' for operational tracking, 'Last Radius' for dependency mapping, and charts for exploit analysis and best practice adoption. A live API and Telegram bot (public broadcast and personal subscription) are also implemented. An AI auto triage feature for critical events is mentioned for a 'Team tier'.

The project has built an app with user sign-up (local or email-friendly, plus 'phantom bullet' for queer producers). It features a main page with an emergency report function activated by a press-and-hold action, which creates a report with live location. Users can open reports, select incident types, and receive guidance on what to preserve and report. The app supports saving notes with local encryption and uploading photo, video, or audio evidence, which is encrypted with AES 256GC before storage. For verification, evidence hashes and timestamps are encoded on Solana Devnet. A community help feature allows users to request support, and supporters can chat privately. An anonymized map displays aggregated safety signals from group reports. 'Dial pages' allow survivors to request legal aid and mental aid, with verified professionals joining via SBT-style credentials. Magic block is mentioned for privacy-focused review coordination.

A working AI system that automates the creation of real estate valuation reports. It can learn an appraiser's style and template, create rules for sections, and connect to data sources to generate full documents. It currently has three paying customers.
A crypto learning course is proposed.
A property search platform with listings for rent, purchase, and investment properties, accessible via a website.

A downloadable application package that includes a terminal environment and a separate browser-like graphical user interface (GUI). The terminal provides system commands and an AI logic router for natural language interaction. The GUI includes a local search engine, 15-16 games, various study labs (medical, maths, physics), a word processor with PDF export, a timetable maker, and a personalized dashboard. It also features multi-layer root protocol authentication, a sandboxed environment, and tools for live telemetry (net-stat tracing) and hexadecimal memory inspection.
A system that runs a full AI model on a mobile phone, an X402 payments plugin, and integrations for autonomous Solana micropayments.
A product is live on Solana, ready for its first real companion, implementing milestone-based funding with on-chain escrow and backer voting.

The platform is operational, and users can access several interactive AI avatars including Aegis (email intelligence), Harmonia (AI mentor), Lyra (intelligence transition adaptation), and Atheria (ecosystem guide). The demo shows a live product, not a slide deck or code walkthrough.

The project claims to connect physical reality to on-chain states within 400 milliseconds. It is also claimed to be a product ready to be shipped, rather than an MVP, though this readiness lacks explicit implementation proof.
A voice-native agent powered by ElevenLabs for conversational AI and integrated with Solana for trusted execution, utilizing the X402 protocol for micropayments.

A Multi-Compliance Protocol (MCP) server that generates zero-knowledge proofs and submits them to Solana, returning attestation addresses. A PNOC program orchestrates four Solana primitives (Shadow Drive, Light Protocol, Pinocchio, Squads) in a single atomic transaction. The system includes 66 MCP tools covering privacy, AML, and AI governance, 14 Solana programs on devnet, 435 green tests, and U.A. Act plus four AI governance frameworks already in production.
